title: Amrutha Varshini
desc: Abhishek falls in love with Veena, who is married to Hemanth. Things begin to swirl out of control when an obsessed Abhishek decides to kill Hemanth to get him out of the way.

title: Mufti
desc: Gana, a police officer, must go undercover to find and kill Bhairathi Ranagal, a crime lord. However, when he realises that Bhairathi's intentions are good, he needs to decide his next step.

title: Natasaarvabhowma
desc: An investigative journalist, Gagan, moves to Bengaluru and ends up living in a supposedly haunted house. Soon, he realises a change in his behaviour after falling prey to supernatural activities.

title: Max
desc: Inspector Arjun arrests two men for crashing into the police station. Soon, he desperately rushes to clear his name as the two are found dead.

title: Mithra Mandali
desc: Comedic adventure and chaos erupt in the simple lives of a group of misfit friends after one of them begins to fall in love with the feisty, headstrong daughter of a politician.

title: G.O.A.T
desc: After a tragedy tears him apart from his wife, Gandhi, a former elite spy, is forced back into the field for a mission of the utmost importance.
